method: Read only neutral inputs,sources and rubric for these labels. Prior generic identity-contract/question/code review is disclosed: second annotator is not prompt-blind. No author labels/build/README or model outcomes read. Author first labels were created without adapter wording/code. Trusted identity is assumed only from independently installed receipt+private snapshot; it never supplies operative facts.
